response.justification: The candidate brings genuine geospatial experience (founder of GISCollective, Green Map GIS work) and strong low-latency systems background (DLang microservices handling millions of requests/sec at Sociomantic), but falls short on the core requirement of modern C++ or Rust — his C++ work dates to 2014-2015 and recent years have been dominated by TypeScript/Node.js product work. There is no navigation guidance or routing pipeline experience, making him an adjacent rather than direct fit worth a conditional conversation.
strengths: Hands-on geospatial data platform experience (GISCollective, Green Map GIS apps)
Low-latency, high-throughput systems work with async I/O, caching, and fibers at Sociomantic
Broad full-stack versatility and demonstrated willingness to learn beyond comfort zone
concerns: Modern C++ experience is minimal and roughly a decade old; no Rust listed
No experience with routing engines, navigation guidance, or map tiling pipelines
Recent roles centered on TypeScript/Node product work, not systems-level engineering
